ifs-lakebench: ecLand vs. ESA-CCI-Lakes LSWT

24 lakes, 2017-2022. TLWML (FLake mixed-layer temperature) and AvgSurfT (skin temperature) vs. the CCI Lakes LSWT product, spatially averaged over each lake's bounding box. "Overpass" samples the model at the MODIS Terra overpass UTC hour (10:30 local solar time, per lake longitude) instead of a daily mean -- the correct comparison against a polar-orbiter's instantaneous retrieval.
